Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

The petitioners, vide the present petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., seek quashing of FIR No.666/2020 dated 18.12.2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS: Wazirabad,
Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement Agreement dated 09.11.2021 arrived at between the parties before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts,
Delhi.

sentences.text: This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Agreement dated 09.11.2021 [Annexure-P2] and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3. Petitioner nos. 1 to 3 as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/12/2023 at 02:19:19 4.
Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 11.04.2023.

sentences.text: 1 she has voluntarily settled all her disputes with the petitioners, of her own accord without any duress, coercion or pressure and states that she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the petitioner and has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.
7. In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors.
Vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466

sentences.text: , this Court is of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.
8. Accordingly, the petition is allowed and FIR No.666/2020 dated 18.12.2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS: Wazirabad, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed.
9. The petition stands disposed of.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J DECEMBER 12, 2023/rr
